    People also ask
    What vaccines do I need for travel?
    Some countries require proof of vaccination for travellers wishing to enter or exit the country.
    • Diphtheria. Hepatitis B. Haemophilus influenzae type b. Human papillomavirus. Seasonal influenza.
    • Measles. Mumps. Pertussis. Rubella. Pneumococcal disease.
    • Poliomyelitis (Polio) Rotavirus. Tetanus. Tuberculosis (TB) Varicella.

    Vaccines and travel - World Health Organization (WHO)


    World Health Organization
    https://www.who.int › travel-advice › vaccines
    World Health Organization
    https://www.who.int › travel-advice › vaccines
    What vaccines are necessary for travel?
    Here is a list of possible vaccines that you may need to get for the first time or boosters before you travel.
    • COVID-19.
    • Chickenpox.
    • Chikungunya.
    • Cholera.
    • Flu (Influenza)
    • Hepatitis A.
    • Hepatitis B.
    • Japanese encephalitis.

    Centers for Disease Control and Prevention | CDC (.gov)
    https://wwwnc.cdc.gov › travel › page › travel-vaccines
    Centers for Disease Control and Prevention | CDC (.gov)
    https://wwwnc.cdc.gov › travel › page › travel-vaccines
    What vaccines should I take before travelling?
    Hepatitis A and B vaccinations are a must for many destinations with higher risks of exposure. Additionally, don't overlook the importance of typhoid fever, and tetanus and diphtheria boosters to ensure you're well-protected during your travels.

    Travel Vaccinations in Malaysia: What You Need


    Dr.Prevents 24 Hours Clinics Around KL & Selangor

    Are travel vaccinations necessary?
    Some countries require you to be vaccinated against certain diseases before you can visit. If you do not have the required vaccinations, they may refuse your entry, or require you to have the vaccination(s) at the border. Talk to your doctor about which vaccines or boosters you may need before you travel.
